# Ascent Group Construction

> Self-performing specialty contractor for building envelope, restoration, painting, and interior trades in the Greater Toronto Area.

Ascent Group Construction is a Toronto-based specialty contractor serving commercial, multi-residential, institutional, and residential clients across the Greater Toronto Area. We self-perform — our crew are direct employees, not subcontractors — and bring 15+ years of combined hands-on experience across the trades we deliver. We carry $2M commercial general liability and full WSIB coverage.

We are a Sto Canada Listed Installer and apply manufacturer-specified systems from Sto, Dryvit, Parex, Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Sika, Tremco, Dow Corning, AkzoNobel, and Carboline.

## Service area
Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Newmarket, Aurora, Hamilton, King City.

## Services
- [EIFS & Stucco](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/eifs-stucco-systems): Sto Canada Listed Installer for EIFS installation, repair, and recoats across the GTA.
- [Building Envelope](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/building-envelope-solutions): Cladding, sealants, masonry, waterproofing, and façade systems for commercial and multi-residential buildings.
- [Masonry Restoration](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/masonry-restoration): Brick repair, stone restoration, tuckpointing, and structural masonry across the GTA.
- [Commercial Painting (GTA)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/commercial-painting-gta): Self-performed commercial painting for offices, warehouses, ICI, and multi-tenant buildings across the GTA, with off-hours scheduling.
- [Fire Retardant & Intumescent Coatings](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/fire-retardant-coatings-ontario): Intumescent coatings on structural steel for GCs and architects, plus fire-rated interior paint for condo corridors and property managers, applied to Ontario Building Code requirements.
- [Exterior Painting (Toronto)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/exterior-painting-toronto): Stucco repaints, EIFS recoats, brick, masonry, and metal exterior painting across the GTA using manufacturer elastomeric and acrylic systems.
- [Caulking & Sealants (Toronto)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/caulking-sealants-toronto): Building envelope caulking, window perimeter sealing, expansion joint renewal, and full-building sealant replacement programs.
- [Interior Painting (Toronto)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/interior-painting-toronto): Self-performed interior painting for offices, condos, retail, and homes across the GTA, using low-VOC Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams, and PPG systems.
- [Residential Exterior House Painting (GTA)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/residential-exterior-painting-gta): Full-house exterior repaints for detached homes, townhomes, and semis — stucco, siding, brick, trim, doors, and garages.
- [Tile Installation (Toronto)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/tile-installation-toronto): Porcelain, ceramic, stone, and large-format tile for commercial washrooms, lobbies, and residential bath/kitchen, with Schluter-KERDI and Mapei waterproofing.
- [Flooring Installation (GTA)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/flooring-installation-gta): Luxury vinyl plank, laminate, engineered hardwood, and commercial sheet vinyl installation across the GTA, with substrate prep and condo acoustic underlayment.
- [Drywall Patching & Handyman (Toronto)](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/handyman-patching-toronto): Drywall patching, paint touch-ups, small carpentry, door adjustments, fixture swaps, and tenant turnover punch-lists for property managers and commercial owners.
- [Waterproofing](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/waterproofing-systems): Foundation, roof, parkade, and envelope waterproofing using membrane and coating systems.
- [Parking Garage Restoration](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/parking-garage-restoration): Concrete repair, waterproofing, traffic coatings, and full structural rehabilitation.
- [Painting Services](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/painting-services): Interior, exterior, and protective coatings for commercial and residential clients.
- [Interior Buildouts & Finishing](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/interior-buildouts-finishing): Drywall, taping, and interior trade finishing.
- [Tile & Flooring](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/tile-flooring): Commercial and residential tile installation.
- [Cladding Systems](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/cladding-systems): Metal, composite, and panel cladding installation.
- [Façade Remediation](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/facade-remediation): Exterior façade restoration, panel replacement, and envelope remediation for commercial and multi-residential buildings across the GTA.
- [Residential Interior Renovations](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/interior-finishing-renovations): Whole-home and suite-level interior renovations — drywall, finishing, paint, and trade coordination.
- [Sealant Programs](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/sealant-programs): Multi-year envelope sealant maintenance programs for property managers — Sika, Tremco, Dow, Pecora.

- [Sustainable Building](https://www.ascentgroupconstruction.com/services/sustainable-building)
